fidelity: F2a — Physics-Lumped Closed-Cycle Ammonia Rankine with HX Thermal ODE
source: Avery, W.H. & Wu, C. (1994), Renewable Energy from the Ocean: A Guide to OTEC, Oxford Univ. Press; Vega, L.A. (2002/2012) OTEC Primer, Mar. Technol. Soc. J. 36(4):25-35; Nihous, G.C. (2007) J. Energy Resour. Technol. 129(1):10-17; Faizal & Ahmed (2011) Int. J. Low-Carbon Tech. 6:215.

P_gross_design_kw.note: Design gross turbine power (Avery & Wu 1994 plant class)

UA_evap_kw_per_k.note: Evaporator overall conductance U*A. Plate HX U~3-5 kW/m2K over ~10^4 m2 of area; sized for NTU~3.5 (eps~0.97) so warm stream cools ~2.8 K at 1 MW-gross class (Avery & Wu 1994 Ch.6)

UA_cond_kw_per_k.note: Condenser overall conductance U*A. Slightly larger than evaporator (Avery & Wu 1994)

C_evap_kj_per_k.note: Lumped thermal capacitance of evaporator metal + ammonia liquid hold-up

C_cond_kj_per_k.note: Lumped thermal capacitance of condenser metal + ammonia liquid hold-up

T_warm_in_c.note: Warm surface seawater inlet (typ 24-28 degC tropics; Vega 2002)

T_cold_in_c.note: Cold deep seawater inlet from ~1000 m (typ 4-7 degC; Vega 2002)

mdot_warm_kg_s.note: Warm seawater mass flow (~3-4 m3/s per MW gross; Avery & Wu 1994)

mdot_cold_kg_s.note: Cold seawater mass flow (~2-3 m3/s per MW gross; Avery & Wu 1994)

cp_seawater_kj_per_kg_k.note: Seawater specific heat at S=35 g/kg, 5-26 degC (Sharqawy et al. 2010, Desal. & Water Treat. 16:354)

rho_seawater_kg_per_m3.note: Seawater density S=35, ~15 degC (Sharqawy et al. 2010)

eta_turbine.note: Ammonia turbine isentropic*mechanical*generator efficiency (Avery & Wu 1994; Vega 2002)

eta_sw_pump.note: Seawater pump combined efficiency (dominates parasitic; Vega 2002)

eta_carnot_fraction.note: Fraction of Carnot delivered by real low-dT ammonia Rankine across the HX dT (typ 0.5-0.6; Nihous 2007)

dP_warm_pump_kpa.note: Net warm-water loop pumping head (friction in HX, screens, short intake); the deep-pipe static head is largely recovered, so net parasitic is small. Calibrated to Vega 2002 net parasitic ~20-30% of gross

dP_cold_pump_kpa.note: Net cold-water loop pumping head, larger due to ~1000 m cold-water-pipe friction (static density head largely recovered); Vega 2002

p_evap_kpa.note: Ammonia evaporator (high-side) pressure ~ Psat(~24 degC). NH3 Psat: 970 kPa @24C (NIST)

p_cond_kpa.note: Ammonia condenser (low-side) pressure ~ Psat(~10 degC). NH3 Psat: 615 kPa @10C (NIST)

h_fg_nh3_kj_per_kg.note: Ammonia latent heat of vaporisation ~1186 kJ/kg @10C, ~1166 @24C (NIST WebBook); lumped
